headline: Donald Trump really wants Tim Cook to run Nvidia
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid reports of affairs and an alleged spy. President Trump publicly suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook as his replacement. The company's CFO is currently leading on an interim basis.

headline: Xbox announces Wolfenstein 3
summary: Xbox officially announced Wolfenstein 3 from MachineGames, a sequel to 2017's The New Colossus. The announcement follows news of The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. Fans have waited nearly a decade for the next installment.

headline: Whoop launched a social network where every user has a ‘verified heartbeat’
summary: Whoop introduced 'Whoop Humans,' a new social network for its wearable users. Members can share metrics, activities, and achievements, along with 'Moments' with photos. Whoop boasts an 'entirely human' platform with 'verified heartbeats'.

headline: Humble Bundle redesign removes two-factor verification from settings
summary: Humble Bundle's new storefront redesign has removed options for two-factor verification (2FA) in settings. Users can no longer add or update their 2FA methods. This security oversight has been reported by outlets like Kotaku and PC Gamer.

headline: Fortnite is Teasing a Big Reveal For Captain X, Its Mysterious Masked Treasure Man
summary: Fortnite is teasing a major reveal for its December 5 live event. The event promises to unmask the mysterious new character, Captain X. Fan theories for Captain X's identity range from Mr Beast to Obama.

headline: Microsoft Struggling to Fix Global System Outage Impacting Email Systems and More
summary: Microsoft is facing a prolonged global systems outage affecting services like Outlook and Teams. The company admitted that initial repair efforts are 'not taking as expected'. This widespread disruption continues to impact users worldwide.

headline: GTA 6's Burger Shot Restaurant Is Expanding Across Florida With Real Meals Inspired by the Game
summary: GTA 6's fictional fast-food chain, Burger Shot, is expanding with real-world locations in Florida. The restaurants will offer meals directly inspired by the game. This immersive experience is thanks to a collaboration with Skinny Louie.

headline: The He Who Fights With Monsters Hardcover Books Are on Sale Before Black Friday
summary: Hardcover editions of 'He Who Fights With Monsters' are currently on sale. This special offer precedes the official Black Friday sales event. Fans can grab copies at a reduced price now.

headline: What we know about the global outage
summary: Microsoft confirmed its global system outage was not due to a cybersecurity incident. Efforts to fix the widespread issues have so far been largely unsuccessful. The disruption continues to affect numerous online services.

headline: Office workers express concerns over Microsoft disruption
summary: Office workers, including insurance brokers, report significant job disruption due to the Microsoft outage. Many describe their work as completely hindered by the ongoing issues. Some see the prolonged disruption as a concerning 'sign of what's to come'.

headline: Firm offers to fake artworks for wealthy migrants seeking UK 'talent' visas
summary: A BBC investigation uncovered an elaborate fraud scheme for UK 'talent' visas. A firm offered to fake artworks for wealthy migrants to secure fast-track settlement. Undercover operations exposed the illicit practices.

headline: Piddington to bring legal challenge over asylum base plans
summary: Piddington is preparing a legal challenge against plans for a new asylum base. The proposed site near Piddington, Oxfordshire, could house up to 1,256 men. Local opposition is mounting against the controversial development.
